subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should ordinary agent `write` expose append as `append?: boolean`, or should maintainers require a `mode` field or a separate append tool before merge?
rationale: Source and issue evidence show the missing primitive causes real data loss, but the permanent model-facing tool shape is a maintainer-owned API/product decision.

options.title: Accept boolean append
options.body: Land the narrow optional `append?: boolean` contract because it preserves overwrite-by-default behavior and directly fixes the reported workflow.

options.title: Switch to explicit mode
options.body: Require a `mode: "overwrite" | "append"` style contract before merge if maintainers want future write modes to share one field.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Pause this PR and require a dedicated append tool if maintainers want destructive overwrite and append to be distinct model-facing tools.

recommendation.title: Accept boolean append
recommendation.body: Land the narrow optional `append?: boolean` contract because it preserves overwrite-by-default behavior and directly fixes the reported workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across both the agent runtime/tool boundary and the session routing surface touched by the PR.
